aros_history.DIARY: Matter called up and taken up in Board Mr. Asif, Court clerk of counsel for the Plaintiff is present and states that no record of evidence is available with them for re-constitution of the evidence file. He is directed to file a statement in this regard, staement to be filed in a weeks' time. Adjourned to 28-02-2024.

Matter called and taken up in Board. Mr. Hameed Hussain, Court Clerk of Mr. Ovais Hameed, Advocate is present. None present for the plaintiff. As per the Hon'ble Court's order dated 29.11.2023, learned counsel for the plaintiff was required to submit to this office any record available with him for the reconstitution of evidence file, however, notice issued to the learned counsel for the plaintiff for 17.01.2024, returned un-served as per bailiff report due to the relocation of his office. On the other hand, Mr. Hameed Hussain court clerk of Mr. Ovais Hameed, Advocate states that no record of evidence is available with them. He is directed to file a statement in this regard. Statement to be filed in two weeks' time. In the meanwhile, repeat notice to the learned counsel for the Plaintiff at the fresh address: Suite Nos. 412, 413 Paradise Chamber near Passport Office, Saddar, Karachi. Adjourned to 14.02.2024.

As per Court's order dated 24.08.2021 in S. No. 245 of 2003, further three months' time was granted to learned President High Court Bar Association to do the needful. For the time being captioned matter is adjourned to 22.09.2021.

Matter called and taken up in board. Order dated 04.03.2021 passed in Suit No. 245/2003 in which the Hon'ble Court was pleased to order that as informed due to severe illness of Mr. Abdul Shakoor Dehlvi Advocate/Commissioner he was unable to conclude the Commission and even despite making requests and appointing officials of this Court to make contact with him and to receive evidence part/file from him, no fruitful result had come out. Mr. Salahuddin Ahmed Advocate, President, High Court Bar Association was directed to take personal interest in the matter by making contact with Mr. Abdul Shakoor Dehlvi Advocate/Commissioner and subsequent order dated 29.03.2021 Mr. Salahuddin Ahmed Advocate, President High Court Bar Association stated that he made contact with Mr. Abdul Shakoor Dehlvi Advocate and requested him for return of evidence part/file; however, he informed him that he had no evidence file at his home and the same must be lying in his locker of High Court Bar Association. He has told him that he would locate the key of the locker; however, in case he failed to search out, he would depute a family member for breaking the lock of the locker and handover files to him. Mr. Salahuddin Ahmed Advocate requested for two weeks' time to do the needful. Time was granted. That Suit No. 1001/2005 is also mentioned in the list provided in Suit No. 245/2003 of pending cases lying before learned Commissioner. Suit No. 245/2003 is fixed in Court on 24-08-2021, for the time being captioned matter is adjourned to 08-09-2021.
Notice issued to the Ld. Commissioner Mr. Abdul Shakoor Dehlvi, Advocate returned served. No report has been filed by the Ld. Commissioner since 17.04.2017. Fix in Court for further orders.

As per Court's order dated 17.04.2017, Mr. Abdul Shakoor Advocate was appointed as a Commissioner and four months time was granted to conclude the evidence, which has expired on 16.08.2017, but the office was not fixed the matter last five months. Office is directed to be careful in future. Call report from the Ld. Commissioner. Adjourned to 21.02.2018.

Notice repeated to the learned Commissioner returned served as per bailiff report. No report has been submitted by the learned Commissioner since 08.10.2021. Fix in the Hon'ble Court for further orders on 25.03.2022.
Notice issued to the learned Commissioner but no bailiff report has been submitted. repeat notice to the learned commissioner for 9/3/2022

As per the Hon'ble Court's Order dated.08-10-2021, Mr. Abid Feroze Advocate was appointed as Commissioner and three months' time was granted to conclude the evidence, which has expired. No report has been submitted by the learned commissioner since 08-10-2021. Issue notice to the learned commissioner for 09-02-2022.

A Statement dated: 25.08.2021 has been filed by Syed Muhammad Mohtashim, Advocate, son of the learned Commissioner Syed Tauqir Hasan in which he informs that Syed Tauqir Hasan has passed away. Fix in Court for order as to the substition of the learned Commissioner or any other order deemed fit and proper by the Hon'ble Court on 10.09.2021.
Notice issued to the learned Commissioner returned served as per bailiff report. No report has been filed by the learned Commissioner, since 23.10.2020. Fix in Court for further orders on 9-4-2021.

As per Court's order dt: 23-10-2020, four months' time was extended to conclude the evidence, which has expired. No report has been filed by the learned Commissioner since 23-10-2020. Issue notice to Commissioner for 31-3-2021.
As per Court's dated 26.04.2018 60 days time was granted excluding the period of Summer Vacation, which has not yet expired. Adj. to 12.09.2018.
The matter is already fixed in Court on 14/05/16. Adj to 24/08/16. Additional Registrar (OS)

aros_history.DIARY: Notice issued returned unserved as per bailiff report. Repeat notice through all modes except publication for 30.03.2022.

As per the Additional Registrar O.S. diary the office was directed to issue notice to FIA Authorities to provide particulars and addresses of defendants Nos. 1 & 3. In compliance of the above diary notice issued to FIA Authorities returned served and FIA Authorities have provided particulars and address of defendants No. 1 & 3. Issue notice to the defendants No. 1 & 3 at the fresh address for 09.02.2022.

Matter called and taken up. Perusal of record reveals that matter was fixed before Hon???ble Court on 05.03.2018 when Hon???ble Court was pleased to direct that some counsel for defendants had died so notice be issued to concerned defendants in person before placing the matter in court. In view of this order matter was taken up in board on 02.05.2018. Perusal of record reveals that defendant No.3 was ordered to proceed exparte vide Hon???ble Court order dated 11.10.1999 based on diary of Additional Registrar dated 23.09.1999 subsequently thereto on 25.01.2010 Hon???ble Court observed that since the matter is fixed on evidence but there is nothing on record to suggest that defendants No.3 & 4 was ever served and ordered that process be repeated. Subsequently thereto office had pointed out that vide board diary dated 22.08.2000 plaint was struck of against defendant No.4 on failure of plaintiff to get the process issued. Upon such office note on 30.05.2011 Hon???ble Court was pleased to recall the said order whereby the plaint was struck of against defendant No.4. However in the board diary dated 02.05.2018 it was so observed that vide this order of Hon???ble Court dated 02.05.2011 order of repeating service upon defendant No.3 was recalled but seems to be oversightly so mentioned. At first instance notice was issued to plaintiff to come forward and get the process issued. Subsequently thereto summon and notices were issued to defendants No.1, 2 & 3 and continuously been issued. Consequently Mr. Walid Anwar Ansari filed power on behalf of defendant No.2. Record further reveals that defendant No.4 after plaint was restored filed written statement on 08.06.2013. However Mr. Waleed Anwar Advocate filed power on behalf of defendant No.2 and on 21.04.2021 it was so observed that on failure to file written statement defendant No.2 was debarred. Today office has so brought notice that defendant No.2 had already filed written statement which is on record on 25.03.2000 so as that by defendant No.1. It seems that such order was passed oversightly hence stood recalled. In nutshell by perusal of record written statement by defendants No.1, 2 & 4 are already on record while for defendant No.3 which was previously ordered to proceed exparte and subsequently Hon???ble Court ordered to issued fresh summon. Summon issued which returned served upon defendant at his office while for defendant No.1 it was so informed that he is retired. Lastly matter was taken up in board and on failure of plaintiff to get the process issued upon defendants No.1 & 3 plaint were struck of but since written statement on behalf of defendant No.1 already on record as such order to the extent of defendant No.1 is recalled. Office is directed to issue notice to FIA Authorities to provide particulars and address of defendants No.1 & 3 and also issued process upon defendant No.3 through DG FIA. Adjourned to 12.01.2022.

Court motion notice issued to the Counsel for the Plaintiff returned served as per bailiff report. As per the Hon'ble Court's order dated: 05.03.2018 office was directed to issue notice on the fresh address if given by the learned counsel for the plaintiff but since 05.03.2018 the counsel for the Plaintiff has failed to provide the fresh address of Defendant Nos. 1 & 3, for affecting service upon them in terms of order dated 05.03.2018. In view of above the plaint is struck off against the defendants Nos. 1 & 3 for not providing the fresh address in terms of Court's order dated: 05.03.2018 for getting proven, Fix for directions. Adj to 17.11.2021.

Matter called and taken up in the Board in view of court order dated 05-03-2018. Perusal of record reveals that written statment by defendant No.1 & 2 was filed while defence was struck of defednant No. 3 as well as of 6 while plaint was struck of against defendant No. 4 & 5, Subsequently on 04-12-2016 draft issues were submitted which are adopted and matter was fixed for evidence. On 25-01-2010 order was passed by the Honorable Court to repeat the process upon defendant No. 3 & 4 through all modes. Subsequently, vide order dated 02-05-2011 order of repeating the service upon defendant No. 3 was recalled and directed to the plaintiff to get the process issued against defendnat No. 4 &5 against whom plaint was struck of. The process was issued and subsequently written statement by defendant No 4 was filed while defendant No. 5 was ordered to be proceeded ex-parte vide order dated 10-09-2012 and the matter was fixed before the court for additinal issues, if any. Meanwhile Honorable Court directed to issue notice against defendants as thier counsel has died. In pursuance of court order dated 05-03-2018 plaintiff is directed to provide fresh address for issuance of noticews to defendant in person. The matter should not be placed before the court as long as service is not made by the Plaintiff while issue notice to the plantiff and his counsel.
